quote:
You carry secrets you never meant to keep.
The silence grows heavier within your chest.
Every unspoken word becomes a quiet prison.
You wonder if anyone will ever notice.
Yet you keep hiding behind painted smiles.
Some burdens are meant to be shared.
Drop the heavy armor before it breaks you.
